extraction.quote_span: Patchy snow in the last half mile, totally walkable, the little ones loved the snowfield glissade near the top.

detail.quote: Patchy snow in the last half mile, totally walkable, the little ones loved the snowfield glissade near the top.
detail.text: Took the kids up Mono Pass out of Mosquito Flat on the 4th. Patchy snow in the last half mile, totally walkable, the little ones loved the snowfield glissade near the top. Rock Creek footbridge means no wet feet. Great early summer option.
